messages.subject: Please delete my Drafto account
messages.summary: Asks for their Drafto account and all their data to be deleted; no longer has the app installed.
messages.content:
<email>Hi,

I stopped using Drafto a few months ago and have already removed the app from my phone, so I can't get into the settings any more.

Please delete my Drafto account (sam.okafor@example.com) and all the data you hold on me: notebooks, notes, attachments, everything.

Could you reply to confirm once it's done?

Thanks,
Sam</email>
